resolution.note: ship retries HTTP 429/502/503/504 on reads, prints verdict before cleanup and turns cleanup errors into warnings, title task beats KRN_TASK, usage states 69/70, pid record replaces cmdline check; tests in test/ci/ship*.test.ts pass

title: Ship survives a transient API error, prints its verdict before cleanup and states every exit
body:
Source: Fable architecture review, report .krn/runs/arch-review/architecture.md (section 5, M-items). The review is read-only, and every scenario comes from reading the code.
Evidence and fixes, each with its regression test:
- src/ci/ship.ts:63-64: a single HTTP 502 or 429 while waiting for Check ends ship with exit 70 and leaves the PR open with no verdict. Fix: retry transient API errors with backoff.
- src/ci/ship.ts:868-876 (M6): the verdict is printed only after the release script and cleanup finish, so a throw there turns a merged PR into a non-zero exit. Fix: print `verdict: merged` first and treat cleanup errors as warnings.
- src/ci/ship.ts:306: KRN_TASK from the environment wins over the task id in the title, so the claim or record can land on the wrong task. Fix: the title wins, or refuse when they differ.
- src/ci/ship.ts:34 and 719 (M14): exits 69 and 70 are missing from the usage text, and a plain Error exits 64. Fix: document every exit and give every error path a stated code.
- src/ci/ship-live.ts:25-28: a ship run inside `krn lane run` has no "ship" in its cmdline, so it reads as orphaned and a second ship can start. Fix: detect a live ship by its record or lock, not by cmdline.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, src/ci/ship-live.ts, src/cli-kit/command-error.ts, test/ci/ship*.test.ts
Outcome: all five defects fixed, each with a test at the lowest layer (KRN-14).
Proof: the new tests fail on the base and pass on the branch.
